title: Gradient world schematic
slide_intent: Expose the structure behind an effect so designers can reproduce a family of environments consistently.
strategic_value: A shared cube construction can keep Channel 4’s varied gradients spatially related.
demonstration: The film pulls back from a blue room to a cube with outlined planes, then cycles through color variants before returning to the room view.
practical_value: Compare the front-facing gradient result with the oblique construction view.

content_islands.name: Room result
content_islands.spec: Begin and end with the full-frame blue gradient room.

content_islands.name: Construction view
content_islands.spec: Show the cube and outlined planes on black, then compare alternate colored cubes.

reference_purposes.Application: The animation reveals a cube construction behind the gradient-room appearance.
